column1: # Total basis: whole-image AOT range manifest.

column2: function start — UpdateGreenFramebufferTileGrid; increments the task age and invokes its deletion callback when controller two presses the exit button.
function start — DrawGreenFramebufferTileGrid; projects and submits a green-tinted 16 by 16 grid sampling a 128 by 128 framebuffer region.
function start — DeleteGreenFramebufferTileGrid; unregisters both work-list tasks releases the grid allocation and restores projection-depth shift state.
function start — CreateGreenFramebufferTileGrid; allocates the task and builds both textured triangles for each cell of the double-buffered framebuffer grid.
